parsed.note_claim: Views of the Willis Tower from across Lake Michigan do not show its bottom due to Earth's curvature; only upper portions are visible.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In reality, they failed to account for the height of the observer or atmospheric refraction and ignored the fact that only the upper parts of the buildings are visible.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly states that only the upper parts of the buildings are visible and confirms this observation is consistent with a spherical Earth.
